events.notes: Renamed from "medium change" (2026-08-10) — this is "next day" after the 2026-09-02 seeding, matching Umut's plan to transduce the day after seeding, with viruses frozen before vacation. Day 1 of the 6-day transduction+hygromycin-selection window (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-08), which ends on a Tuesday (not Fri/Sat/Sun) per Umut's constraint.

events.title: Pellet for RNA and Protein (SRB cells)
events.notes: 2026-08-10: this replaced today's SRB seeding — Umut pelleted and froze the cells he was going to seed for SRB (rather than seeding), since the SRB experiment itself is postponed to after vacation. Not a baseline-from-plate pellet; it is the preservation step for the postponed batch.

events.title: RNA isolation (ATF3 rep 3, cells seeded 08-10)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: RNA isolation (ATF3 rep 3) — done on 08-11 as originally scheduled. Umut confirmed it was completed, so it was not carried into 08-12.

events.title: LunaScript cDNA conversion (ATF3 rep 3)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: LunaScript cDNA conversion (ATF3 rep 3) — done on 08-11, straight off the RNA isolation. Umut confirmed it was completed, so it was not carried into 08-12.

events.title: Thaw cells (Hek and Huh7 ATF3 mutants)
events.notes: From -80C. No experiment same day (thaw-cell rule). Mandatory medium change next day (2026-09-01). Duration defaulted to 1h.

events.title: Thaw cells (CuAdapts)
events.notes: From -80C. No experiment same day (thaw-cell rule). Mandatory medium change next day (2026-09-01). Duration defaulted to 1h. Separate from the ongoing recurring CuAdapt passage/copper-feeding routine.

events.title: Medium change (CuAdapts, newly thawed)
events.notes: Mandatory day-1 medium change after 2026-08-31 thaw (thaw-cell rule). Duration defaulted to 1h.

events.title: LNCX and LUCX Virus
events.notes: Mandatory day-1 medium change after 2026-08-31 thaw (thaw-cell rule) — this is the recovery-flask medium change, separate from the 2026-09-02 seeding into assay wells at 100k/well. Duration defaulted to 1h.

events.title: LNCX and LUCX hygromycin selection — day 6 check
events.notes: End of the 6-day transduction+selection window (2026-09-03 - 2026-09-08). Falls on a Tuesday, satisfying the no-Friday/weekend-end constraint. Duration is a short checkpoint, not a full protocol step.

events.title: TCA wash (discard, wash 5x, tap dry)
events.notes: 2026-08-10 correction: previously missing — TCA fixation needs this active wash step after the passive incubation, not just the initial "add TCA" step. protocols.md SRB Assay steps 3-5. 15 min per Umut. 2026-08-10 CANCELLED: postponed to after vacation return (no specific date yet) — one of the planned cell lines died after puromycin selection; Umut will substitute from a previous replicate once back. Do not delete; regenerate SRB chain (seeding -> treatment -> TCA fixation) once a return date is picked.

events.title: CuAdapt cells — passage (one-off, missed Monday)
events.notes: One-off catch-up for the passage skipped on Monday 08-10. Placed after the copper treatment (ends 13:30) with the required 10-min gap. Does not affect the recurring Mon/Thu passage schedule. 2026-08-11: marked done by Umut from the app — not carried into 08-12.

events.title: Boil protein samples — setup
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Hands-on half of the 30 min boil: calculate concentrations, add loading buffer, set the heat block. The 15 min at 95 C that follows is unattended.

events.title: Send plasmids to sequencing
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Fits exactly into the 15 unattended minutes while the samples are at 95 C, per Umut.

events.title: Western — samples at 95 °C
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Unattended 15 min of the boil. Cool on ice afterwards. Plasmids go to sequencing in this window.

events.title: Western — load gel
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Last hands-on step before the run; everything after this is unattended until the transfer is assembled.

events.title: Western — SDS-PAGE run
events.notes: 2026-08-11: A standard run, ~1.5 h. Real endpoint is the dye front reaching the bottom of the gel, so treat the clock as a guide. Virus medium change and CuAdapt copper happen in this window.

events.title: Western — assemble wet transfer
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Build the sandwich, cold buffer and ice pack, start the transfer.

events.title: Western — wet transfer (2 h)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Unattended. qPCR prep runs in this window. No antibody step can start until this finishes.

events.title: Western — block (BSA, not milk)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 1 h at room temperature. BSA/TBS-T — milk carries endogenous biotin and would compete with the target for streptavidin.

events.title: Western — streptavidin-HRP
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 1 h at room temperature. Conjugated, so there is no secondary antibody step today.

events.title: Western — ECL + image (biotin)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Mix the substrate, 1-5 min on the membrane, image straight away — the signal fades within the hour.

events.title: Western — membrane to 4 °C
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Store in TBS-T at 4 C overnight; stripping happens tomorrow morning.

events.title: Colony formation — fixation
events.notes: 15 min, Umut's value. Fixation only; staining and counting are separate.

events.title: Colony formation — fixation
events.notes: 15 min, Umut's value. Fixation only; staining and counting are separate.

events.title: Western — strip #1 (20 min)
events.notes: First of two strip cycles today. 20 min, Umut's value.

events.title: Western — block (BSA in PBS)
events.notes: BSA, not milk — same biotin/streptavidin rule as day 1.

events.title: Western — streptavidin blot (2nd probe)
events.notes: Re-probing with streptavidin before moving to the second target.

events.title: Western — visualization (streptavidin)
events.notes: = ECL + image, 20 min.

events.title: Western — strip #2 (20 min)
events.notes: Second strip, same membrane, for the new primary target.

events.title: Western — block (5% milk in TBST)
events.notes: Milk is fine here — this target is not biotin/streptavidin detection.

events.title: Western — primary antibody (overnight, +4 °C)
events.notes: Starts 15:30, continues overnight at 4 °C past this window — block marks the start, not the real finish (same convention as Colony formation drying). Wash + secondary begin ~08:00 the next morning.

events.title: Western — washes (after primary)
events.notes: Continuation of the overnight primary from 13 Aug.

events.title: Western — washes (after secondary)
events.notes: Starts after CuAdapt FREEZE (09:00-09:30) clears, with 10 min to spare.

events.title: Western — visualization (2nd target)
events.notes: = ECL + image, 20 min.

events.title: Set up YY1 PCR (MORF library template)
events.notes: Nek2(K37R) → YY1 swap in pCDH backbone. Primers already in hand. PCR runs first, alone — both digestions start together only once this is done. Whole day moved 45 min earlier (was 09:00) so ligation can go overnight and Umut is still out by ~16:40 instead of past 23:00 — see cloning.md.

events.title: YY1 PCR run (thermocycler)
events.notes: Nek2(K37R) → YY1 swap. Q5/HF-style run, ~1.3 kb product.

events.title: Set up YY1 insert + pCDH backbone digestion
events.notes: Nek2(K37R) → YY1 swap. BamHI-EcoRI double digest, both reactions set up together so they run in parallel — per Umut. Now runs before the 10:00-10:30 LNCX seed instead of after it, since the whole chain moved earlier.

events.title: YY1 insert digestion (BamHI-EcoRI)
events.notes: Nek2(K37R) → YY1 swap. 4h digest of the PCR product — duration per Umut, overrides the ~5-15 min NEB Time-Saver default. Runs alongside the backbone digest, finishing together. Ends right when Umut is free again after the 12:20-13:20 CuAdapt thaw, so no time is lost either way.

events.title: pCDH-Nek2(K37R) backbone digestion (BamHI-EcoRI)
events.notes: Nek2(K37R) → YY1 swap. 4h digest, excises Nek2(K37R) and linearizes the vector — duration per Umut. Runs alongside the insert digest, finishing together.
